mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sales_order (order_no, customer_id, user_id, total_amount, payment_method, status, order_date, remark) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{customerId}, #{userId}, #{totalAmount}, #{paymentMethod}, #{status}, #{orderDate}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE sales_order SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT so.*, c.name AS customer_name, c.phone AS customer_phone, u.real_name AS operator_name FROM sales_order so LEFT JOIN customer c ON so.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON so.user_id = u.id WHERE so.id = #{id}

SELECT so.*, c.name AS customer_name, c.phone AS customer_phone, u.real_name AS operator_name FROM sales_order so LEFT JOIN customer c ON so.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON so.user_id = u.id WHERE so.order_no = #{orderNo}
SELECT MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(order_no, 11) AS UNSIGNED)) FROM sales_order WHERE order_no LIKE CONCAT('SO', #{datePrefix}, '%')

SELECT so.*, c.name AS customer_name, c.phone AS customer_phone, u.real_name AS operator_name FROM sales_order so LEFT JOIN customer c ON so.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON so.user_id = u.id WHERE so.customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY so.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_order WHERE customer_id = #{customerId}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, SUM(total_amount) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS count FROM sales_order WHERE status != 2 AND YEAR(order_date) = #{year} AND MONTH(order_date) = #{month} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS date, SUM(total_amount) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS count FROM sales_order WHERE status != 2 AND YEAR(order_date) = #{year} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY date
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y') AS date, SUM(total_amount) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS count FROM sales_order WHERE status != 2 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y') ORDER BY date

SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.name AS product_name, pc.name AS category_name, SUM(soi.quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(soi.subtotal) AS total_amount FROM sales_order_item soi JOIN sales_order so ON soi.order_id = so.id JOIN product p ON soi.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN product_category pc ON p.category_id = pc.id WHERE so.status != 2 AND so.order_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY p.id, p.name, pc.name ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.id AS product_id, c.name AS product_name, COALESCE(c.phone, '散客') AS category_name, COUNT(*) AS total_quantity, SUM(so.total_amount) AS total_amount FROM sales_order so LEFT JOIN customer c ON so.customer_id = c.id WHERE so.status != 2 AND so.order_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.phone ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS count FROM sales_order WHERE status != 2 AND YEAR(order_date) = #{year}
